about: NATIVE_MODEL_REGISTRY room package for r118 with both PS2 cast members (lane p2b item B2): the female Ganado (em17 / em16 type 0xc, PS2_GANADO_F, GC hair mask) and the parasite dog (Colmillos, em22, PS2_WOLF). Render only; the descriptors are the ones of ps2-ganado-f17-mask (ps2cast-3) and ps2-wolf (ps2cast-4), from one merged cast dir (merge_cast.py). POOL: em17 type 0xc as ganado-em17-0cp (NATIVE_MODEL_REGISTRY_POOL).
lighting: the source GX lighting record (NATIVE_MODEL_REGISTRY_SOURCE_LIGHT bits 2 and 4), as the source path lights them today; em22 source cull
